verdict.rationale: Datalab documents conversion into structured Markdown/HTML/JSON and says Marker 'handles complex layouts', which implies layout-aware parsing, but no evidence explicitly describes preserving headings, section hierarchy, or reading order. A hands-on user found output 'reasonable' but with columns intermingled in tricky cases, so reading-order fidelity is unproven. Document Segmentation only returns page ranges for multi-document splits, which is a different capability and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit docs on heading/section hierarchy in output, a documented reading-order guarantee, a JSON block-tree/hierarchy schema, and independent corroboration of structure preservation on multi-column layouts.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, parsed output preserves document hierarchy — headings, sections, reading order — so downstream LLMs see structure, not soup
